english.note: Use 潮 as the all-purpose casual choice for something trendy or currently in fashion.
Use this when stylish mainly means fashionably current or trendy, especially for clothes and young people.

examples.english: These fashionable sneakers are hard to buy these days.
examples.jyutping: ni1 paai4 ciu4 ge3 bo1 haai4 hou2 naan4 maai5

examples.english: These wide-leg trousers are stylish and trendy.
examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 fut3 goek3 fu3 hou2 ciu4
